goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that take too long to send a complete request
Prevents slow-trickling clients from exhausting RPC connection slots and blocking legitimate callers
agreement: Strong support with no remaining objections
Concept support because it mitigates slow-loris attacks and report churn (pinheadmz)
Praised test cleanup, with open questions on test server cleanup and assertions (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it mitigates a denial of service where slow byte trickling exhausts RPC connection slots
Unauthenticated connections can currently hold slots indefinitely and block legitimate callers
